description: This file defines various classes for HTTP authentication schemes in FastAPI, including Basic, Bearer, Digest, and generic HTTP authentication, along with their credentials data models and utility methods.

classes.name: HTTPBasicCredentials
classes.description: Represents HTTP Basic authentication credentials with username and password.

classes.name: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
classes.description: Holds the scheme and credentials extracted from the HTTP Authorization header.

classes.name: HTTPBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for HTTP authentication schemes, providing common logic and interface.

classes.name: HTTPBearer
classes.description: Implements HTTP Bearer token authentication scheme.

classes.name: HTTPDigest
classes.description: Stub class for HTTP Digest authentication, primarily for OpenAPI schema purposes.

methods.name: dict[str,str] make_authenticate_headers(self)
methods.description: Generates the appropriate WWW-Authenticate header for the authentication scheme.

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Creates an HTTPException indicating authentication failure.

methods.name: Optional[HTTPBasicCredentials] __call__( self, request: Request )
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts and validates authentication credentials from the incoming request, raising errors or returning None based on configuration.

                By default, if the HTTP Bearer token is not provided (in an
                `Authorization` header), `HTTPBearer` will automatically cancel the
                request and send the client an error.

                is not available, instead of erroring out, the dependency result will
